text:
mira: PM for the 03/20 inference hiccup is live. We need concrete test workstreams: regression unit, burst load job, prompt-set expansion, and a focused chaos exercise. Quick owner + ETA replies please.
owen: I can own the regression harness for the prefix/KV path. Small unit + an integration that runs in staging CI. Target: 4 days.
li: I'll build a k6-based burst/soak workflow and a scheduled GH Action plus Grafana dashboard. Plan to simulate many short requests + random payload sizes. ETA: 6 days.
samar: I'll take the chaos experiment. Plan: tabletop first, then staged fault injection on replicas to trigger eviction. Success criteria: fallback in <30s and no silent quality regressions.
eva: I'll expand prompt sets to capture cache-miss tails and model-swap cases. Will aim for ~70 inputs and a small evaluation harness. ETA: 7 days.
mira: Please also link PRs back to PM-4567 and add labels: incident-test, priority-high, owner-<name>.
owen: Note: regression should include a tiny micro-eval that compares outputs pre/post fallback to catch swap regressions. I'll pair with eva on thresholds.
li: Sketch of GH Action I'll add:
```
name: incident-burst
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 2 * * 3' # weekly early morning
jobs:
  run-burst:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/k6_run.sh --script k6/burst_short.js --vus 1000 --duration 60s
```
li: Dashboard: track 95p latency, error rate, and KV-eviction spikes. Will wire alerts to #incidents.
samar: For the chaos run I'll script: cycle one replica every 20s for 2m during a burst test. Verify routing, cache repop timing, and 95p latency.
ops-bot: PM-4567 created and linked by @mira: https://pm.redwood/company/PM-4567
mira: Timelines recap:
- Regression PR & micro-eval: owen 1812345678 +4 days
- K6 load job + dashboard: li 1812345678 +6 days
- Prompt-set + evals: eva 1812345678 +7 days
- Chaos tabletop + staging exercise: samar 1812345678 next Tue
mira: Also ask eng-sre to add a recurring query for KV cache eviction spikes (monthly). @li can you coordinate ops handoff?
li: Yup. I'll file an ops ticket and include a sample PromQL and suggested thresholds.
owen: I'll open GH issue and PR; will include a short README for how to run the regression locally and in CI.
eva: Prompt set repo I'll use: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/incident-pm-4567-cache. PR will include pass/fail thresholds and examples.
samar: I'll post the chaos playbook draft in #eng-oncall and run a tabletop this Friday, live stage next Tue 10am PT if folks ok.
mira: Please drop a short comment in the GH issue when your PRs are created so we can count them in the weekly follow-up. Meeting Friday 9am PT to review staging canary. If blockers show up, escalate here. :thumbsup:
